cocycle: phi(a) = log3 - a log2  on the Syracuse valuation shift; centered psi = phi - Ebar, Ebar = log3 - 2log2

trivial_cycle.note: trivial cycle sits at the mean: centered sum = 0 (it is the ONE periodic orbit that balances 2^S = 3^K up to ... well 2^2 vs 3^1, it does NOT balance -- Sigma_psi=0 means S=2K, i.e. 2=2*1, true).

coboundary_verdict.mechanism: constant-word period-p orbits give Sigma_psi=p(2-c)log2, linear in p, sign set by c<2 (up) or c>2 (down); the all-ones word -> +p log2, the all-threes word -> -p log2.
coboundary_verdict.cohomology_class: nontrivial in H^1: [phi] != 0; drift is a genuine (non-trivializable) cocycle class.
